VEHICLE INCURSION PROCEDURES:

1. Alert all workers - shout, radio, air horn

2. Workers move to safe area/escape route

3. Call 911 - provide location, injuries

4. If safe, provide first aid to injured

5. Stop all work until area secured

6. Assess and repair damaged traffic control devices

7. Incident investigation - preserve evidence

WORKER STRUCK PROCEDURES:

1. Call 911 immediately - provide location

2. DO NOT move victim unless in immediate danger

3. Control bleeding - apply direct pressure

4. Keep victim calm and warm

5. Direct emergency responders to scene

6. Stop all work until investigation complete

FLAGGER EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

1. If vehicle does not stop, move to escape route

2. Warn other flaggers via radio

3. Do not pursue vehicle

4. Call 911 with vehicle description and direction

5. Report incident to supervisor

TRAFFIC CONTROL DEVICE DAMAGE PROCEDURES:

1. If devices damaged, position worker with flagger to warn traffic

2. Immediately replace/repair devices

3. If unable to repair, close lane until devices restored

WORK STOPPING AUTHORITY:

All personnel have the authority and responsibility to stop work if conditions become unsafe.

Stop work conditions include:

- Inadequate traffic control setup

- Missing/damaged signs or devices

- Poor visibility (fog, rain, darkness without lights)

- Vehicle incursions

- Flagger safety compromised
